item.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Transgender Student Notification Sparks Debate in LGBTQ-Rich Coachella Valley
item.description: A new ruling from the U.S. Supreme Court is intensifying debate over how schools handle transgender student issues, particularly in communities like the Coachella Valley, which has one of the largest LGBTQ populations per capita in the United States.The court blocked a state policy that limited when schools could inform parents if a student identifies as transgender or requests different pronouns.
